nota: Relido: o memorando (DSB de 07/02/1955) pede lei de "a single basic wage scale for all U.S. and Panamanian employees"; a PL 85-550 (relida): "The basic wage for any given grade level will be the same for any employee eligible for appointment ... without regard to whether he is a citizen of the Republic of Panama or of the United States". A data de 25/01/1955 é do dossiê (assinatura do tratado), não relida por mim.
